label: exploratory
kind: real-data download, structural inspection and reference estimation (the EXP-005 'fit')
purpose: Download FI-2010 (owner-approved, CC BY 4.0), check its structure, and estimate the real-market reference values on the reference split (days 1..9) by the method written in protocol section 12 R1 before fitting. No simulation parameter is fitted; no simulated output and no EXP-001 contrast is used; the held-out day 10 was read for validity and segment counts only.
code_revision: c1369b252d02ce81e215b287929755b0eac6f272 plus uncommitted working tree (committed in the freeze-preparation commit of the same day)
commands: inline structural check: market.realdata.load_matrix + ingest counts + quantiles and top 60 of |diff log mid| (reference file); ingest counts and segment sizes at J = 0.1 (both files)

data.download_wall_time: about 52 min (19:31 to 20:23 CET, about 0.6 MB/s)

structural_inspection.finding: Four jumps above 0.2 and none between 0.035 and 0.26: the files are ordered by stock then day (5 segments, not 45 stock-days). Day boundaries are not identifiable (no timestamps). The method was revised to stock segments (J = 0.1) and 9,000-column blocks BEFORE any reference statistic was computed (protocol section 12 R1, revision note).
structural_inspection.decimal_precision_scale: ask and bid share one scale (tick 0.0001, i.e. one cent at a factor of 100), so log returns and relative spreads are unaffected by the normalisation

not_done: No placement of simulated values against these references was computed, for pilot or confirmatory runs. Held-out statistics not computed.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1
